# Durian Rules
## Overview

Everyone can see the other clerks’ fruit cards but not their own. Keep taking fruit orders without asking for more fruit than the shop has — and ring the bell when you think the last order went too far.

Durian supports 2–7 players and takes about 20 minutes.
## Game Objective

In Durian, you are a fruit-shop clerk who can see everyone’s inventory except your own. Your goal is to judge when orders have gone too far, ring the bell at the right time, and finish with the least manager anger.
## Components

- 28 Fruit cards
- 3 Mischievous Gorilla cards
- 1 Order board
- 7 card stands
- 7 Angry Manager chips
- 1 handbell
## Set Up

![Every clerk has one inventory card; you can see all other cards but never your own card](/images/rules/durian/hidden-inventory.svg)

1. Give each player a stand and one card from the shuffled deck. Put it in the stand facing **away** from its owner: everyone else can see it, but the owner cannot.
2. Put the Order board in the middle, with the bell beside it. The space marked with a check is the side of each Fruit card that counts as an order.
3. Stack the Angry Manager chips in number order, with the lowest value available first. Put the remaining cards face down as the draw deck.

Use the two-player setup from the rulebook when playing with two players: it uses one extra visible inventory card.
## Your Turn: Take an Order or Ring the Bell
### Take an order

![Draw one card, then choose exactly one of its two fruit sides as the new order; the other side does not count](/images/rules/durian/take-order.svg)

Draw the top card.

- **Fruit card:** It shows two fruit groups. Choose **one** side as the new order and slide that side beneath the check on the Order board. The fruit on the other side is ignored.
- **Gorilla card:** Put it next to an earlier Fruit order, then flip that Fruit card around. The order now uses its other side instead.

After taking an order, the next player takes a turn. You never secretly look at your own inventory card.
### Ring the bell

Anyone may ring the bell when they think the current orders are more than the fruit in stock. Stop immediately and check.

![Ring the bell to compare all ordered fruit against total stock: too many orders blames the last order-taker; enough stock blames the bell-ringer](/images/rules/durian/ring-bell.svg)

1. Reveal all inventory cards and count the fruit in stock.
2. Count the fruit that is currently ordered (the sides under the check).
3. Apply any Gorilla effects that are in the inventory before comparing the totals.

| Check result | Who takes the next Angry Manager chip? |
|---|---|
| Orders exceed stock | The player who took the most recent order. |
| Stock covers every order | The player who rang the bell. |

After the check, collect the cards, shuffle, and deal fresh hidden inventory cards. Continue from the next turn.
## The Three Gorilla Siblings

When a Gorilla card appears as an **order**, it flips an earlier Fruit order as described above. When a Gorilla card is sitting in the hidden inventory, reveal it during a bell check and use its sibling effect:

| Gorilla | During the check |
|---|---|
| **Mitsuhiko** | Ignore every order side that shows **3 fruits**. |
| **Nana** | Ignore every **banana** order. |
| **Moo** | No special effect. |
## Game End

Angry Manager chips are worth increasing amounts. When a player’s total Angry Manager value reaches **7 or more**, the game ends immediately. The player with the **lowest** total anger wins.
## Quick Reminders

- You may ring the bell even when it is not your turn.
- The owner of an inventory card must not see it until a bell check reveals it.
- Only the chosen side of each Fruit order counts; an order flipped by a Gorilla immediately uses its new side.
## Quick reference
Jump directly to the rule topic you need.

- <!-- rule-item: flow-setup -->
  **Hide Your Own Inventory**

  Give everyone one stand and one inventory card facing away from its owner. You can see every other player’s inventory, but never your own. Put the bell and Order board in the middle.

  Related topics: 
  - [What do I do on my turn?](#flow-turn)
  - [Why can’t I see my card?](#flow-inventory)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-inventory -->
  **Everyone Else Knows, You Guess**

  All inventory cards together are the shop’s stock. Because your card faces away from you, you infer it from the visible cards, the orders, and other players’ behavior.

  ![Every clerk has one inventory card; you can see all other cards but never your own card](/images/rules/durian/hidden-inventory.svg)

  Related topics: 
  - [Take an order](#flow-take-order)
  - [Back to setup](#flow-setup)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-turn -->
  **Take an Order or Ring the Bell**

  On your turn, either draw one card and add an order, or ring the bell because you believe the current orders exceed stock. Any player may ring the bell at any time.

  Related topics: 
  - [Draw and take an order](#flow-take-order)
  - [Ring the bell now](#flow-ring-bell)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-take-order -->
  **Draw 1, Choose 1 Side**

  Draw the top card. For a Fruit card, choose exactly one side and slide that side under the check on the Order board; only that fruit group counts. A Gorilla card flips one earlier Fruit order to its other side.

  Related topics: 
  - [A Fruit card](#flow-fruit-order)
  - [A Gorilla card](#flow-gorilla-order)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-fruit-order -->
  **Choose the Order Side**

  Pick one of the card’s two fruit groups. Put that side in the counted order area; the other side does nothing. Then pass the turn, unless someone rings the bell.

  ![Draw one card, then choose exactly one of its two fruit sides as the new order; the other side does not count](/images/rules/durian/take-order.svg)

  Related topics: 
  - [Continue taking orders](#flow-turn)
  - [Check for overselling](#flow-ring-bell)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-gorilla-order -->
  **A Gorilla Flips an Old Order**

  Place the Gorilla card beside any earlier Fruit order, then turn that Fruit card around. From now on, its other fruit side is the order that counts.

  Related topics: 
  - [Continue taking orders](#flow-turn)
  - [Ring the bell](#flow-ring-bell)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-ring-bell -->
  **Reveal and Compare**

  Reveal every inventory card. First apply any Gorilla effects in the inventory. Then compare total ordered fruit with total stock: if orders are higher, the most recent order-taker gets angry; otherwise the bell-ringer gets angry.

  ![Ring the bell to compare all ordered fruit against total stock: too many orders blames the last order-taker; enough stock blames the bell-ringer](/images/rules/durian/ring-bell.svg)

  Related topics: 
  - [Orders really exceed stock](#flow-anger)
  - [Stock is enough](#flow-anger)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-anger -->
  **Take Anger, Reset, Continue**

  The blamed player takes the next Angry Manager chip. Collect and shuffle the cards, deal fresh hidden inventory cards, then continue. If any player has anger worth 7 or more, the game ends; lowest anger wins.

  Related topics: 
  - [Nobody has 7 anger](#flow-turn)
  - [Someone reached 7](#flow-winner)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-winner -->
  **The Calmest Clerk Wins**

  When a player reaches 7 or more anger, stop immediately. Compare Angry Manager values: the lowest total wins.

  Related topics: 
  - [Set up another game](#flow-setup)

# 榴莲忘返规则
## 概览

每个人都看得见别人的库存牌，却看不见自己的。大家不断接水果订单；你要猜订单有没有超过库存，并在你觉得“卖超了”的那一刻按铃。

支持 2–7 人，约 20 分钟。
## 游戏目标

在《榴莲忘返》中，你是一名看得见别人库存、却看不见自己库存的水果店店员。你的目标是判断订单是否卖超、在正确时机按铃，并在结束时让经理怒气最少。
## 配件

- 28 张水果卡
- 3 张捣蛋猩猩卡
- 1 块订单板
- 7 个卡架
- 7 枚经理怒气指示物
- 1 个手铃
## 游戏准备

![每位店员有一张库存牌；你能看见其他所有人的牌，却永远看不见自己的牌](/images/rules/durian/hidden-inventory.svg)

1. 每人拿一个卡架和一张洗好的牌。把牌**背对主人**插进卡架：其他人都能看见，只有牌的主人看不见。
2. 把订单板放中间，铃放旁边。订单板上有勾的那一侧，表示水果卡哪一边算作订单。
3. 经理怒气指示物按数字从小到大叠好。剩余牌面朝下放成牌堆。

双人游戏请使用规则书中的专用准备：会多放一张大家都看得见的库存牌。
## 你的回合：接订单，或按铃
### 接 1 张订单

![摸一张牌后，二选一：只让其中一边水果成为新订单，另一边不计算](/images/rules/durian/take-order.svg)

从牌堆摸顶牌。

- **摸到水果卡：**卡的两边各有一组水果。你必须选**一边**作为新订单，把这一边朝着订单板的勾放进去；另一边完全不算。
- **摸到猩猩卡：**把它放到一张先前的水果订单旁边，然后把那张水果卡翻过来。那张订单从现在起改算另一边的水果。

接完订单后，换下一位玩家行动。任何时候都不能偷看自己的库存牌。
### 按铃检查

任何人觉得订单总数已经超过库存时，都可以立刻按铃。马上停下并检查。

![按铃后比较订单水果与库存水果：订单真的超了，最后接订单的人挨骂；库存够，按铃的人挨骂](/images/rules/durian/ring-bell.svg)

1. 翻开所有库存牌，数一数店里有多少水果。
2. 数一数现在已经接了多少订单（订单板勾那一侧的水果）。
3. 先处理库存里的猩猩效果，再比较两个总数。

| 检查结果 | 谁拿下一枚经理怒气指示物？ |
|---|---|
| 订单比库存多 | **最后接订单的人**。 |
| 库存足够完成所有订单 | **按铃的人**。 |

检查完后，收回所有牌、洗牌，再发一轮新的隐藏库存牌；从下一回合继续。
## 三只捣蛋猩猩

猩猩卡被当作**订单**摸到时，会把一张先前水果订单翻面，规则如上。猩猩卡若藏在库存里，则在按铃检查时翻开，并使用对应效果：

| 猩猩 | 检查时的效果 |
|---|---|
| **Mitsuhiko** | 所有画着 **3 个水果**的订单都不算。 |
| **Nana** | 所有**香蕉**订单都不算。 |
| **Moo** | 没有额外效果。 |
## 游戏结束

经理怒气指示物的数值会越来越大。当任一玩家拿到的怒气总和达到 **7 或以上**时，游戏立刻结束。怒气总和**最少**的人获胜。
## 快速提醒

- 不轮到你时也可以按铃。
- 库存牌的主人在按铃翻牌前不能看自己的牌。
- 每张水果订单只有被选中的一边算数；被猩猩翻面的订单从翻面后立刻改算新的一边。
## 快速查阅
从这里快速跳到相关规则条目。

- <!-- rule-item: flow-setup -->
  **藏好自己的库存牌**

  每人拿一个卡架和一张库存牌，牌要背对主人。你看得见所有别人的库存，唯独看不见自己的。把铃和订单板放中间。

  相关主题：
  - [轮到我做什么？](#flow-turn)
  - [为什么我看不见自己的牌？](#flow-inventory)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-inventory -->
  **别人知道，你来猜**

  所有库存牌加起来，就是店里的库存。你的牌背对你，所以只能通过看得见的牌、已经接的订单和其他人的反应来猜。

  ![每位店员有一张库存牌；你能看见其他所有人的牌，却永远看不见自己的牌](/images/rules/durian/hidden-inventory.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [接 1 张订单](#flow-take-order)
  - [返回准备](#flow-setup)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-turn -->
  **二选一：接订单或按铃**

  轮到你时，要么摸 1 张牌并接订单，要么因为觉得订单超过库存而按铃。任何玩家在任何时候都能按铃。

  相关主题：
  - [摸牌并接订单](#flow-take-order)
  - [现在按铃](#flow-ring-bell)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-take-order -->
  **摸 1 张，只选一边**

  摸顶牌。水果卡只能选一边，朝着订单板的勾放进去；只算这一边。摸到猩猩卡时，选一张先前水果订单，把它翻到另一边。

  相关主题：
  - [摸到水果卡](#flow-fruit-order)
  - [摸到猩猩卡](#flow-gorilla-order)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-fruit-order -->
  **选这一边当订单**

  从两边水果里选一边，放进“要计算的订单”区域；另一边不算。然后换下一位，除非有人按铃。

  ![摸一张牌后，二选一：只让其中一边水果成为新订单，另一边不计算](/images/rules/durian/take-order.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [继续接订单](#flow-turn)
  - [检查有没有卖超](#flow-ring-bell)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-gorilla-order -->
  **猩猩把旧订单翻面**

  把猩猩卡放到任一张先前水果订单旁边，再把那张水果卡翻面。之后改算它另一边的水果。

  相关主题：
  - [继续接订单](#flow-turn)
  - [按铃检查](#flow-ring-bell)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-ring-bell -->
  **翻库存，比总数**

  翻开所有库存牌。先结算库存里的猩猩效果，再把订单总数和库存总数比较：订单更多，最后接订单的人挨骂；库存够，按铃的人挨骂。

  ![按铃后比较订单水果与库存水果：订单真的超了，最后接订单的人挨骂；库存够，按铃的人挨骂](/images/rules/durian/ring-bell.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [订单真的超过库存](#flow-anger)
  - [库存其实够](#flow-anger)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-anger -->
  **拿怒气，重发库存，继续**

  挨骂的人拿最上面那枚经理怒气指示物。收回并洗牌，重新发隐藏库存牌后继续。任一人怒气累计到 7 或以上，游戏结束；怒气最少的人赢。

  相关主题：
  - [还没人到 7 怒气](#flow-turn)
  - [有人到 7 怒气](#flow-winner)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-winner -->
  **怒气最少的人赢**

  有人怒气达到 7 或以上就立刻停下。比较所有人的怒气总和，最少的人获胜。

  相关主题：
  - [开始新游戏](#flow-setup)
## 快速查阅
从这里快速跳到相关规则条目。

- <!-- rule-item: flow-setup -->
  **藏好自己的库存牌**

  每人拿一个卡架和一张库存牌，牌要背对主人。你看得见所有别人的库存，唯独看不见自己的。把铃和订单板放中间。

  相关主题：
  - [轮到我做什么？](#flow-turn)
  - [为什么我看不见自己的牌？](#flow-inventory)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-inventory -->
  **别人知道，你来猜**

  所有库存牌加起来，就是店里的库存。你的牌背对你，所以只能通过看得见的牌、已经接的订单和其他人的反应来猜。

  ![每位店员有一张库存牌；你能看见其他所有人的牌，却永远看不见自己的牌](/images/rules/durian/hidden-inventory.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [接 1 张订单](#flow-take-order)
  - [返回准备](#flow-setup)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-turn -->
  **二选一：接订单或按铃**

  轮到你时，要么摸 1 张牌并接订单，要么因为觉得订单超过库存而按铃。任何玩家在任何时候都能按铃。

  相关主题：
  - [摸牌并接订单](#flow-take-order)
  - [现在按铃](#flow-ring-bell)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-take-order -->
  **摸 1 张，只选一边**

  摸顶牌。水果卡只能选一边，朝着订单板的勾放进去；只算这一边。摸到猩猩卡时，选一张先前水果订单，把它翻到另一边。

  相关主题：
  - [摸到水果卡](#flow-fruit-order)
  - [摸到猩猩卡](#flow-gorilla-order)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-fruit-order -->
  **选这一边当订单**

  从两边水果里选一边，放进“要计算的订单”区域；另一边不算。然后换下一位，除非有人按铃。

  ![摸一张牌后，二选一：只让其中一边水果成为新订单，另一边不计算](/images/rules/durian/take-order.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [继续接订单](#flow-turn)
  - [检查有没有卖超](#flow-ring-bell)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-gorilla-order -->
  **猩猩把旧订单翻面**

  把猩猩卡放到任一张先前水果订单旁边，再把那张水果卡翻面。之后改算它另一边的水果。

  相关主题：
  - [继续接订单](#flow-turn)
  - [按铃检查](#flow-ring-bell)

  ![按铃后比较订单水果与库存水果：订单真的超了，最后接订单的人挨骂；库存够，按铃的人挨骂](/images/rules/durian/ring-bell.svg)

  相关主题：
  - [订单真的超过库存](#flow-anger)
  - [库存其实够](#flow-anger)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-anger -->
  **拿怒气，重发库存，继续**

  挨骂的人拿最上面那枚经理怒气指示物。收回并洗牌，重新发隐藏库存牌后继续。任一人怒气累计到 7 或以上，游戏结束；怒气最少的人赢。

  相关主题：
  - [还没人到 7 怒气](#flow-turn)
  - [有人到 7 怒气](#flow-winner)

- <!-- rule-item: flow-winner -->
  **怒气最少的人赢**

  有人怒气达到 7 或以上就立刻停下。比较所有人的怒气总和，最少的人获胜。
